skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.auto_kick.che: Which stat Auto-Kick checks - Accessory Power or SkyBlock Level.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.auto_kick.del: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.auto_kick.ena: Automatically /party kick a joining member if their chosen stat below is under the threshold.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.auto_kick.thr: A joining player whose stat is below this gets kicked from the party. Click to type a value directly.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.auto_kick_max: Which stat Max Auto-Kick checks - independent of the min check above, can be a different stat.
Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
For carry parties: automatically /party kick a joining member if their chosen stat below is OVER the threshold - they don't need carrying, and may be taking a slot from someone who does.
A joining player whose stat is OVER this gets kicked from the party. Click to type a value directly.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.boss_room.del: Where either message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.boss_room.ena: Announce when the boss room is entered.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.boss_room.low: Used INSTEAD of the message above when the run's score is under 300 at entry. Placeholders: {player} {score}.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.boss_room.mes: Used when the run's score is still 300+ at entry. Placeholder: {player} ("The party" for the party-wide trigger, or a specific name for the per-player trigger).
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.chat.mention_: Highlight (bold + colored marker) any chat message that mentions your own username, and play a short sound - so a mention doesn't slip by unnoticed.
Marker color for a chat mention of your own username.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.chat.anti_sca: Flags any trade-offer-shaped message in public chat as possible lowball spam - not a judgment of whether a price is actually low. Never applies to party/guild/whisper chat or SkyMelloo Friends.
On = flagged messages are hidden entirely. Off = they stay visible with a warning marker prepended.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.chest_highlig: Highlight chests with a glowing box outline (only when actually in view, not through walls).
Scan radius (in blocks) around you for Chest Highlight.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.cloud_sync.en: Sync your settings to sky.melloo.me while your account is linked - a new device/reinstall under the same account starts from your existing settings instead of all defaults. Requires a linked account in addition to this toggle.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.connection.au: Automatically rejoin Hypixel a few seconds after an unexpected disconnect - Hypixel only, capped at 3 attempts in a row so a real kick/ban doesn't turn into hammering reconnects forever.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.connection.qu: On connecting to a server, show a "Connecting..." title and check ping stability for the first 5 seconds.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.death_message: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Announce in chat when a party member dies during the run.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.delivery_bulk: Sets EVERY delivery setting on this tab (Death Recap, Dungeon Info, Auto-Kick, Boss Room, Death Message, and every other announcement below) to LOCAL at once, instead of clicking through each one individually. You can still change any of them back individually afterward.
Sets EVERY delivery setting on this tab to PARTY at once, instead of clicking through each one individually. You can still change any of them back individually afterward.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.death_recap.d: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.death_recap.e: When you die, post a short chat recap of the last few hits you took and what/who dealt them - real damage-source data, not a proximity guess.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.death_recap.p: Also share a short one-line version with the party (who/what killed you) - independent of the local Death Recap above.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.debug_message: Prints cloud settings push/pull results to chat. Doesn't affect the sync itself.
Where the Cloud Sync debug messages above go. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Prints the dungeon run tracker's floor/cleared%/time detection and run start/end to chat. Does NOT toggle the Score HUD/Run Report/etc. themselves - those are their own options under Dungeons.
Where the Dungeon debug messages above go. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.

Master switch - turns every category below on/off at once. Command replies and safety warnings always show regardless. Every row below only controls whether that system prints extra diagnostic chat messages for troubleshooting - none of them turn the actual feature on or off (e.g. "Party Debug Log" does NOT toggle the Party HUD, it just logs what the Party HUD is doing behind the scenes).
Shows every (color, text) run actually seen in Hypixel's actionbar below the mana bar - for tracking down why mana detection isn't matching.
Prints the Party HUD's username/Accessory Power resolution steps to chat. Does NOT toggle the Party HUD itself - that's the "Party HUD" option under Dungeons.
Where the Party debug messages above go. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Prints whitelist checks and per-feature permission fetches to chat. Admin-only - these messages never show to normal users regardless of this setting.
Where the Permissions debug messages above go. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Prints mod-presence reporting activity (detecting other SkyMelloo users nearby) to chat.
Where the Presence debug messages above go. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Prints staff-encounter scanning activity (/sm hitstaff) to chat.
Where the Staff debug messages above go. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Prints friend list / party sync results to chat. Doesn't affect the sync itself.
Where the Sync debug messages above go. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.distance.show: Show distance in blocks next to highlighted mobs/players/items.
Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
When someone joins your dungeon party finder group, look up their stats and post a summary in chat.
Include Accessory Power in the Dungeon Info message.
IANA timezone ID used for {time}/{date} above, e.g. Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.
Share your current room/floor/secrets/score with party members also running SkyMelloo, and with the sky.melloo.me Dungeon lookup page - relayed over sky.melloo.me, invisible to anyone not running the mod. Room/secrets detail needs Skyblocker installed too (see Show Room Secrets under Dungeons). Also requires Sharing & Privacy's Sync to be on (MellooEssentials settings, key H). Reports once a second, fixed - not adjustable.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.fishing.bitin: Glow color of your bobber the moment it's biting.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.fishing.fishi: Alert when your fishing bobber gets a bite.
Play a sound in addition to the actionbar alert.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.fishing.waiti: Glow color of your bobber while waiting for a bite.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.floor_complet: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Automatically /party kick a member who hasn't ACTUALLY COMPLETED the Required Floor below yet - unlike Floor Auto-Kick above, this checks real completion, not just current level-eligibility.
Minimum floor a member needs to have ACTUALLY COMPLETED before (0 = Entrance, 7 = Floor VII).
Maximum floor a member is allowed to have already completed - anyone who's completed something higher gets kicked by Max Floor Completion Auto-Kick above.
Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
For carry parties: automatically /party kick a member who's ALREADY completed a floor higher than the Allowed Floor below - they have real experience past it and don't need a carry slot.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.floor_kick.de: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.floor_kick.en: Automatically /party kick a member who doesn't currently meet the REQUIREMENTS (Catacombs/Combat Skill, verified in-game) for the Target Floor above - not whether they've ever completed it before.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.floor_kick.re: Minimum floor a member needs to be level-ELIGIBLE for right now (0 = just needs Combat Skill 15 for Entrance, 7 = needs Catacombs Skill 24 for Floor VII).
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.floor_kick.ta: Which floor to benchmark the readiness/stats score and Floor Auto-Kick against (0 = Entrance, 7 = Floor VII) - Accessory Power expectations are very different for Entrance vs. Floor VII, so this has to be set manually.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.floor_kick_ma: Maximum floor a member is allowed to already be level-eligible for - anyone eligible for something higher gets kicked by Max Floor Auto-Kick above.
Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
For carry parties: automatically /party kick a member who's ALREADY level-eligible for a floor higher than the Allowed Floor below - they don't need to be carried through it.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.grade_milesto: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Announce live the moment the run's grade first reaches a new tier (C/B/A/S/S+) - each tier only ever announced once per run, even if the grade fluctuates back down and up again.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.hotkeys.open_: Click, then press any key to rebind - same as vanilla's Controls > Key Binds, just without leaving this screen. Escape cancels without changing it.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.hud.health_ma: Master switch - a sleek custom health (green, gold where absorption extends past normal max) and mana (light blue, %) bar pair. Flashes white briefly where health was just lost. Position set via the HUD layout editor (default J).
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.hud.hide_nati: Hides Hypixel's own plain Health/Defense/Mana actionbar text above the hotbar, since the custom bars above already show the same info. Turn off to see both at once.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.hud.side_by_s: Mana bar next to the health bar instead of stacked below it.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.item_highligh: Highlight dropped items with a glowing outline and show their name (only when actually in view, not through walls).
Comma-separated, case-insensitive item name filters. Leave empty to highlight all dropped items.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.lobby_player_: Glow color for the player targeted with /sm search <name> - only works in a Hypixel lobby, not SkyBlock (which has its own party/staff/friend highlighting in MellooEssentials). /sm search clear removes it.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.menu.skymello: A fake "SkyMelloo Menu" item in hotbar slot 8 whenever that slot is empty - right-click to open a chest-style menu for SkyMelloo's own settings, the same way Hypixel's own SkyBlock Menu item (slot 9) works. Client-side only, never overwrites a real item actually in that slot.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.minigame.fish: Pufferfish targets pop up in front of you while your rod is cast - click them before they fully puff up for points.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.minigame.mini: Extra glow tint on the fishing minigame targets.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.misc.show_inv: Makes other invisible players (e.g. from an Invisibility Potion) render normally instead of staying hidden. Not a highlight effect - they're still blocked by walls/line-of-sight like anyone else, just no longer artificially hidden.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.mob_highlight: Glow color for hostile mobs inside your current dungeon room.
During a dungeon run, highlight hostile mobs inside your CURRENT room, so the ones you still need to clear stand out from mobs elsewhere on the floor.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.party.low_hp_: A party member's highlight (glow outline and nametag marker) blinks bright red once their HP drops under 25% - an urgent "someone needs help" signal readable at a glance.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.party.party_j: When someone joins your party, look up their SkyBlock stats (sky.melloo.me/api) and post a summary in chat.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.pre_boss_scor: Used instead of the text above when S+ was already confirmed impossible earlier this run for a different reason (puzzle fail/death/time limit) - avoids implying entering now is what costs the points. Placeholder: {score}
Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Warn the moment the Blood Room fight ends if the run's score is still under 300 (S+) - fires while the boss portal doesn't exist yet, so the party can still decide not to go in.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.puzzle_retry_: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.

Announce when the SAME puzzle fails again after already having failed once (a reset-and-retried room). Doesn't double-penalize Skill score or duplicate the Score HUD line either way - this is purely an optional heads-up.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.rooms_discove: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Announce once per run, the moment cleared% hits 100 (every room discovered), exactly what score is still possible from here - only then is the best-case ceiling not a guess anymore.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.run_tracker.a: Automatically /party kick a member who hasn't moved at all for the threshold below during a run.
How long a member has to stand completely still (seconds) before AFK Auto-Kick fires.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.run_tracker.d: Automatically /party kick a member once their death count for the current run exceeds the threshold below.
Death count a member has to exceed (during one run) to trigger Death Auto-Kick.

Shows the run tracker's own internal state flags (run active, wither door opened, blood room entered/cleared, boss room entered) so you can see at a glance whether detection is actually keeping up. Position set via the HUD layout editor (default J).
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.run_tracker.f: How many seconds the Final Result panel above stays up before the Score HUD disappears.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.run_tracker.p: Compact shows name+AP; Full also shows each member's death count for the current run. Position set via the HUD layout editor (default J).
In FULL mode during a run, show each puzzle that member specifically solved/failed as extra lines under their row - only appears for members actually involved in a puzzle.

A horizontal AP "spread" bar for the party - each member's face is placed along it from lowest to highest AP, range labeled above. Shows the shape of the party's gear gap at a glance. Position set via the HUD layout editor (default J).

A short, separate one-line result sent to party chat when a run ends (score/grade/floor/time only) - independent of Run Report above, which is deliberately never sent to party anymore since a long combined line with many player names in it could crash the game.
Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.run_tracker.r: Track deaths and puzzles solved during the run and post a detailed summary in chat when the dungeon completes - with clickable [Kick] buttons if you're the party leader. LOCAL only, always (see Party Run Summary below to also notify the party).
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.run_tracker.s: Live dungeon score estimate during the run, calculated the same way SkyblockerMod/Skyblocker does - real completed-rooms/secrets%/puzzle-state/crypts from the dungeon tab list, not an optimistic ceiling.
Show the Skill/Explore/Speed/Bonus line on the Score HUD.
When a run ends, keep the Score HUD up for a while showing a distinct "Final Result" panel (frozen final score/breakdown/puzzles) instead of just disappearing the instant the run ends.
Show how many more points are needed to reach the next grade above your current one (e.g. "Next grade (A): +14").
Show an up/down arrow next to the score showing whether it climbed or fell over the last ~10s, plus a persistent "Time left" countdown against the floor's time limit (turns red once past it).
Show the best-case ceiling score ("Possible: X") next to the current total, plus a breakdown of permanent penalties (puzzle fails, deaths) applied so far.
Show the puzzle outcome blocks and solved/failed detail lines on the Score HUD.
Show the current room's secrets found/total and per-secret dots - only ever populated if Skyblocker is also installed.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.s_plus_back.d: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.s_plus_back.e: The counterpart to S+ Impossible above: if the score ceiling recovers back over 300 afterward, say so once. Fires at most once per run either way, so it can never come twice.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.s_plus_imposs: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.
Warn once per run (after a puzzle fail, a death, or the time limit passing) if S+ has become mathematically impossible even in the best case for everything still open. Fires at most once.
Placeholder: {reason} ("a puzzle failed", "a death occurred", or "the time limit passed")
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.secrets_pace_: Where the message above goes. Falls back to LOCAL automatically if you're not actually in a party.

Warn once per run the moment your secret-finding rate first falls behind what's needed to hit the floor's required secrets% before its time limit. Independent of the Time Limit Warning below - this is pace-based, not a fixed countdown checkpoint, so they won't overlap.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.self_ready_re: Nudge yourself via the action bar the moment you're the only one left who hasn't readied up - personal, on-screen only, not sent to chat.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.time_limit_ex: Announce once the floor's time limit is actually exceeded - separate from the S+-impossible warning, which only fires once per run for whichever reason hits first.
skymelloo.gui.settings.tip.time_limit_wa: Where the checkpoint messages above go. The last-10-seconds countdown is always personal/on-screen regardless.
Warn in chat as the floor's time limit approaches, plus a personal on-screen countdown for the last 10 seconds.
Which checkpoint to start warning at (seconds remaining) - everything from here down to 10s fires. E.g. "30" fires at 30s and 10s but not 60s.
skymelloo.gui.settings.title: SkyMelloo Settings
skymelloo.toast.resource_pack_failure.de: Hypixel's pack likely downloaded incompletely - cache was cleared automatically, just reconnect. If it happens again, restart the game.
